title: Weak-* convergence of bounded functions: smooth compactly supported test functions suffice for L¹ weights
statement: Let k ∈ ℕ, C ∈ ℝ, and let F_j (j ∈ ℕ) and F be functions ℝᵏ → ℝ (ℝᵏ = Euclid k with Lebesgue measure) that are a.e.-strongly measurable with |F_j(x)| ≤ C and |F(x)| ≤ C for all j and x. Suppose ∫ ψ·F_j → ∫ ψ·F as j → ∞ for every C^∞ function ψ : ℝᵏ → ℝ with compact support. Then ∫ φ·F_j → ∫ φ·F for every Lebesgue integrable φ : ℝᵏ → ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (Fs : ℕ → Euclid k → ℝ) (F : Euclid k → ℝ), (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (Fs j) (volume : Measure (Euclid k))) → AEStronglyMeasurable F (volume : Measure (Euclid k)) → (∀ j x, |Fs j x| ≤ C) → (∀ x, |F x| ≤ C) → (∀ ψ : Euclid k → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, ψ x * Fs j x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, ψ x * F x))) → ∀ φ : Euclid k → ℝ, Integrable φ → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, φ x * Fs j x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, φ x * F x))
